visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up of a steaming bowl of radish chicken soup in a light-yellow ceramic pot. A wooden spoon stirs the clear broth, revealing tender chicken pieces and translucent white radish slices topped with fresh green onion rings. The setting is a cozy kitchen with soft, bright indoor lighting. (2) A hand places a raw, pink chicken thigh on a large wooden cutting board. A sharp knife is used to carefully trim away yellow fat. The creator sprinkles salt over the chicken and massages it thoroughly with her hands to ensure the seasoning is evenly distributed and the meat is cleaned. (3) The chicken is cut into bite-sized chunks and placed into a metal mesh strainer. A white radish is then peeled repeatedly, sliced into thick sections, and then further cut into thin, semi-circular slices. Three pieces of ginger are also sliced on the cutting board. (4) A glass electric kettle on a digital base is shown heating water. Boiling water is poured from the kettle directly over the chicken pieces in the strainer to blanch them. The chicken is then immediately transferred using tongs into a stainless steel bowl filled with ice water and ice cubes. (5) Fresh cold water is poured into the clean glass pot. The blanched chicken, ginger slices, and radish slices are added one by one. A soup seasoning packet, a small square of kombu, a pinch of salt, and a spoonful of mirin are added to the pot and stirred. (6) The pot is placed onto its electronic base, and the lid is closed. A finger presses the digital buttons to set the temperature to 90 degrees. The display shows the water temperature rising as the soup begins to simmer quietly. (7) After the cooking time, the lid is removed, showing a very clear broth. The creator pours some soup into a small ceramic cup and tastes it. She wears a white t-shirt and a pink apron, standing in a modern kitchen with wooden cabinets and professional appliances. (8) The finished soup is ladled into yellow and pink bowls and garnished with green onions. The woman eats a piece of chicken with chopsticks and smiles warmly at the camera, gesturing with her hands to indicate how delicious the meal is.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 懶人菜單系列❤️. [Subtitle]: 超好喝 蘿蔔雞湯. [Variety]: 清爽無負擔！ (2) [Subtitle]: 去骨雞腿排 清洗乾淨. (3) [Subtitle]: 去除多餘油脂. (4) [Subtitle]: 撒上適量的鹽 去除腥味、增加鮮味. (5) [Subtitle]: 充分搓揉均勻. (6) [Subtitle]: 切成八等份. (7) [Subtitle]: 先放入盆子 裡靜置一下. (8) [Subtitle]: 白蘿蔔 刨去2~3層皮. (9) [Subtitle]: 切出兩等份. (10) [Subtitle]: 剩下的 下次再利用. (11) [Subtitle]: 再對半切. (12) [Subtitle]: 切成薄片. (13) [Subtitle]: 這樣比較快熟. (14) [Subtitle]: 三片薑片. (15) [Subtitle]: 準備95~100度的熱水. (16) [Subtitle]: 將滾燙的熱水 沖燙雞肉. (17) [Subtitle]: 這樣可以去除 雞肉上的腥味跟油脂. (18) [Subtitle]: 立刻撈起來 放入冰水裡 快速降溫. (19) [Subtitle]: 冰鎮的目的：停止加熱、固定肉質. (20) [Subtitle]: 養生壺裡 加入900ml冷水. (21) [Subtitle]: 把雞肉放進來. (22) [Subtitle]: 薑片. [Subtitle]: 蘿蔔片 也放進來. (23) [Subtitle]: 再放入 一包無調味昆布柴魚高湯包. (24) [Subtitle]: 一小塊昆布. (25) [Subtitle]: 一撮鹽調味. (26) [Subtitle]: 一大匙味醂. (27) [Subtitle]: 攪拌一下. (28) [Subtitle]: 放入主機裡... (29) [Subtitle]: 蓋上蓋子. (30) [Subtitle]: 設定90度燉煮. (31) [Subtitle]: 不需要顧火 沒有油煙、沒有水蒸氣 燉煮25~30分鐘. (32) [Subtitle]: 好囉，開蓋❤️. (33) [Subtitle]: 像這樣燉煮 完全不用撈浮沫 湯非常清澈. (34) [Subtitle]: 倒出來試喝一下. (35) [Subtitle]: 天啊~ 太好喝了❤️. (36) [Subtitle]: 用90度燉煮的雞湯 湯 超級清爽. (37) [Subtitle]: ❤️❤️...讚喔. (38) [Subtitle]: 把雞肉放進來. [Subtitle]: 白蘿蔔. [Subtitle]: 蔥花. (39) [Subtitle]: 好香的味道...❤️. (40) [Subtitle]: 簡單就是美味...❤️. (41) [Subtitle]: 雞肉也很嫩嫩..😋. (42) [Subtitle]: 大家一定要試試喔😋. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

The narrator continues her clear, enunciated speech about preparing the ingredients while the cheerful music loop plays at a moderate volume. (3) Rhythmic, high-transient slicing sounds are heard as the knife cuts through the radish and ginger. The narrator's pitch is dynamic and engaging, maintaining a high level of vocal arousal and positive valence throughout the instructions. (4) A splashy liquid sound follows as boiling water is poured over the chicken in the strainer. Immediately after, a metallic clink and wet splashing noises are heard as tongs move the chicken into a bowl of ice cubes. (5) The sound of water pouring into the glass pot is heard, followed by several soft clicks as buttons on the electric base are pressed. The female voiceover remains constant, overlapping with the persistent acoustic guitar music. The creator's voice becomes even more excited as she opens the lid, accompanied by the faint sound of escaping steam. (7) Soft slurping and swallowing sounds are captured as the woman tastes the soup. She lets out a delighted 'Mmm' and speaks with high energy about the flavor. The background music begins a gentle fade-out as the tutorial concludes with closing advice.
